author: EqualMeansEqual
text_post: I'm joining AVfM because I am an egalitarian, meaning that I believe that everyone deserves equal treatment before the law, regardless of gender (or race, religion, sexual orientation, etc., for that matter).  I oppose all forms of discrimination, including the reverse discrimination that has become all too pervasive in our society in recent years.  I am also a male victim of domestic abuse, and I have recently become active, albeit anonymously, to fight back against the stigma and stereotyping that is all too often directly at male victims.  I have started a petition on Change.org calling on President Obama to revise regulations that discriminate against male victims, and I would like to share it on this forum, where I expect that I will find other people who are sympathetic.
